contract.title: Health-only channel execution-path check
contract.requested_prompt: Exercise the execution and extraction paths on a channel with $L = 0.5\,\mathrm{m}$, $H = 0.01\,\mathrm{m}$, span $0.001\,\mathrm{m}$ and inlet speed $U = 0.01\,\mathrm{m/s}$. No physical prediction or validation is requested.

objectives.description: Complete the registered short channel run with intact inputs, the expected mesh, and finite fields; this establishes path health only.

checks.rationale: The solver must exit cleanly at the requested horizon.
A crash or fatal error invalidates this execution-path check.
The generated channel mesh must pass checkMesh.
Every registered meshing command must complete successfully.
All saved field values must be finite for extraction.
The executed case must match its frozen input files.
The declared diagnostic horizon must be reached, not inferred from an early stop.
The realized mesh must match the declared 6000-cell layout.
The spanwise empty patches must give two solution directions.
The channel inlet, outlet, walls and empty patches must exist.

limitations: Execution-path health only; no pressure-drop accuracy, developed-flow, stationarity or mesh-independence claim is made.
The short horizon is selected for a path check, not a physical validation study.
